description: He-Man defends Eternia against Skeletor and a wide range of magical and technological threats while Teela, Orko, Man-at-Arms and the Sorceress become central to the kingdom’s recurring struggles.

s01e01.description: Skeletor convinces his former allies to join him in an attack on the Royal Palace, using a magic Diamond of Disappearance that sends any who look at it into a timeless dimension.

s01e02.description: Skeletor plans to use a mystical comet to turn Eternia into a wasteland. He-Man must convince an old wizard named Zagraz with power over comets to help save his kingdom.

s01e03.description: Evil-Lyn obtains the wicked Shaping Staff, capable of infinite powers of transformation, and enacts an evil scheme to take possession of Castle Grayskull.

s01e04.description: Orko accidentally sends Prince Adam's Sword of Power into the past. Skeletor takes prisoner Adam and waits for He-Man to come to his rescue.

s01e05.description: Skeletor controls Queen Elmora, ruler of the moon of Phantos, and is forcing her to supply him with a powerful metal called Photanium.

s01e06.description: While Teela is looking for her real mother, she is taken prisoner by Mer-Man and only He-Man and Battle Cat can rescue her from becoming a sacrifice for a legendary sea monster.

s01e07.description: Skeletor takes the Spellstone, a mystical object which enables him to control the weather.

s01e08.description: Skeletor goes back in time to build a castle on the same spot as Castle Grayskull is built on in the present. There, he will start the Time Wheel which will go forward in time to where Grayskull is and explode.

s01e09.description: With the help of Beast Man, Skeletor sets an army of dragons on Eternia, then invades Grayskull and uses the powerful Dragon Pearl to weaken and imprison the Sorceress.

s01e10.description: Ileena, a young but self conscious friend of Teela's who despairs at her lack of strength, falls prey to the evil wizard Jarvan, who uses an addictive potion to make her part of an attempt to get his hands on Eternia's Transmutator.

s01e11.description: A man and woman named Aran and Una, tempted by the ways of evil, are taken over by an ancient king and queen when they put on the Masks of Power.

s01e12.description: Evil-Lyn disguises herself as an innocent girl to fool the Widget people into giving her the powerful mineral Coridite.

s01e13.description: Skeletor abducts Man-At-Arms with the help of an evil robot army.

s01e14.description: Skeletor creates his skull-faced ship the Collector that can turn people into stone, but even worse, it can bring stone to life, and he uses it to bring alive the giant stone golem Colossor.

s01e15.description: Beast Man, in the guise of a sideshow owner, comes to Eternos with a carnival in an attempt to lure Cringer into Skeletor's trap.

s01e16.description: Skeletor has abducted Stratos so that he can use the Staff of Avion to summon a monster called Molkrom.

s01e17.description: Orko uses his magic to bring his new friend, Daimar, from another dimension to Eternia. Little does he know is that his new friend's presence is causing trouble on Eternia.

s01e18.description: When Prince Adam's snobbish cousin, Lady Edwina, comes to the palace, Orko is immediately attracted to her, but figures the only way he can impress her is if he finds the Magic Medallion he lost in the Tar Swamp.

s01e19.description: Skeletor wipes He-Man's memory and sends him to a distant, polluted planet called Trannis. Orko, Ram Man and Cringer must travel to this strange world to find He-Man themselves and to face the evil Plundor.

s01e20.description: Dree Elle appears on Eternia begging for help from Orko to save Trolla from a monster called Dragoon which is threatening their home world. Skeletor and his Evil Warriors do not appear in this episode.

s01e21.description: Prince Adam's cousin Jeremy comes to town, but proves to be nothing but a troublemaker for everyone, especially when he unwittingly finds himself aiding Evil-Lyn in her latest scheme.

s01e22.description: The kingdom of Tahryn is living with the permanent threat of being destroyed by a monster called Yog, which can only be kept asleep by the singing of the beautiful Celice.

s01e23.description: Orko's Uncle Montork appears on Eternia, but is taken prisoner and turned evil by the wizard Tauron, who orders him to attack Castle Grayskull.

s01e24.description: A lovelorn wizard named Mallek makes a pact with an evil demon called Lokus to win the heart of Teela, but soon finds himself controlled by the demon.

s01e25.description: Plants are starting to grow wild all over Eternia, causing trouble for both He-Man and Skeletor. The two enemies must team up to defeat Evilseed, a plant like villain looking to take over Eternia for himself.

s01e26.description: Evil-Lyn abducts the daughter of the powerful wizard Kor, and frames He-Man for the crime in the hope that Kor will use his power to defeat He-Man. Tri-Klops appears.

s01e27.description: When Orko's Uncle Montork visits Eternia for a second time, he is followed by an evil magician called Azrog who puts Orko under an evil spell.

s01e28.description: A formerly evil sorceress named Sibyline, who has defected to the side of good, enlists the help of He-Man to help free the Isle of Tears from the rule of her former master, the monstrous Gorgon.

s01e29.description: Skeletor kicks Beastman out of Snake Mountain, because of his failures against He-Man. When Prince Adam discovers that his father views him as irresponsible, Beastman takes prisoner King Randor and take him to Snake Mountain so that Skeletor can take him back.

s01e30.description: Skeletor takes Castle Grayskull, with the Sorceress in it, and transports it to another dimension.

s01e31.description: He-Man finds himself caught up in a war between two rival cities. Losing his memory after a blow, he has to fight an arena gladiator named Garn.

s01e32.description: Prince Adam and Teela embark on a voyage to Selkie Island, to deliver a sonic device called the VHO, but their journey is disrupted by Mer-Man, who wants the VHO for himself.

s01e33.description: Two rival forest tribes are caught in a battle for custody of a little girl with amazing magical powers. He-Man takes her to the Royal Palace.

s01e34.description: Skeletor uses an evil spell to turn Man-At-Arms into a crystal statue. He-Man and Teela seek the aid of the great dragon Granamyr in order to save the life of Man-At-Arms.

s01e35.description: When exploring an ancient, dark castle, Adam and Teela encounter its former rulers, Lord Tyrin and Lady Valtira, who have awoken from a centuries-long sleep.

s01e36.description: Skeletor has discovered the location of the Starseed, a chunk of cosmic matter which will give him unlimited power. He-Man must beat Skeletor to the Starseed before he gains its power.

s01e37.description: He-Man, Man-at-Arms and Teela come to the aid of Chief Merlo, whose daughter Podi has been abducted by Rago, an embittered soldier in Merlo's employ who plans to take over Eternia.

s01e38.description: In the Valley of Power, the stranger Danavas wants to steal the Mother Roe's egg. Teela, Prince Adam, and Cringer are exploring the area in search of magical waters.

s01e39.description: Adam and Teela stumble upon the hidden city of Arcadia, where the men have to work as slaves in underground mines while the women live in luxury in the beautiful city above.

s01e40.description: He-Man, Battle Cat, Ram Man and Orko travel into the desert to investigate a newly risen pyramid, where the trail leads them toward the ancient House of Shokoti and the dangers sealed inside it.

s01e41.description: Stanlan enters Shokoti's pyramid against orders and is taken prisoner, forcing He-Man and the others inside as the sorceress prepares to awaken the Sleeping Beast and spread darkness across Eternia.

s01e42.description: Trap Jaw sets out to find the fuel Eternium, which will give him power equal to that of He-Man. Mer-Man appears.

s01e43.description: Adam tells Man-At-Arms the story of how Man-E-Faces went from being a villain who terrorized innocent people, to a noble hero and actor of the Royal Court.

s01e44.description: Skeletor has taken prisoner Snowflake, the daughter of the Ice Lord, and blackmailed him into capturing the Royal Family as part of the ransom. With the Royal Family held captive, it is up to Orko to release both them and Snowflake.

s01e45.description: Orko's magic is stolen by a small creature which escapes to another world. He-Man and Orko travel to the surreal world of Omiros to get Orko's magic back.

s01e46.description: A villain called Darkdream escapes from his prison and attempts to move the moon to block out Eternia's sun, because darkness increases his power. This causes the moon to fall toward the planet, dooming both unless the moon is returned to its proper orbit.

s01e47.description: While exploring a site of ancient ruins, Man-At-Arms and Professor Smallen are taken captive by ancient robots called the Zactons.

s01e48.description: An evil Electroid called Aremesh comes to Eternia targeting Orko and his powers. While He-Man tries to protect Orko, Skeletor sets out to make a deal with Aremesh himself.

s01e49.description: A mystical orb left by a powerful Gryphon is stolen from the village by Beastman and Trap Jaw where it is guarded, and winds up in the hands of a naive page boy at the Royal Palace.

s01e50.description: Zoar is taken prisoner by a man called Nepthu, who has gained mystical powers in the ancient Temple of The Sun, located on the Sands of Time.

s01e51.description: While investigating the disappearance of some of King Randor's food ships, He-Man and Man-At-Arms find themselves held captive in the underwater city of Aquatica, which has been overtaken by Mer-Man.

s01e52.description: While conducting an experiment, Teela makes a mistake which results in the disappearance of her father. In despair and guilt over her mistake, Teela exiles herself to the Wastelands as self-punishment, while Man-At-Arms himself winds up in the clutches of Skeletor and Trap Jaw.

s01e53.description: Dree Elle returns to Eternia seeking Orko's help in retrieving a dangerous Trollan artifact called the Horn of Evil, which has been stolen by Clawful and Trap Jaw.

s01e54.description: He-Man and his friends are taken prisoner by a villain called Negator who inserts them into a lifelike computer game.

s01e55.description: When a sudden drought strikes Eternia and results in machinery failing and He-Man feeling inexplicably weak, He-Man teams up with a strange insect man called Garth to seek out the cause of the problem.

s01e56.description: While saving two children, He-Man's Power Sword falls into the hands of two dangerous rock creatures, leaving He-Man to enter their lair to retrieve it or face never being able to transform back into Adam.

s01e57.description: A villain called Monteeg visits Skeletor, hoping to recruit He-Man for his Castle of Heroes after passing a series of tests. Skeletor roots for He-Man to pass the tests in the hope that he will be rid of He-Man for good.

s01e58.description: A childhood friend of Adam and Teela's, David the Duke of Abra, appears at the Royal Palace- however he is inexplicably still a child even after all these years and has lost his memory.

s01e59.description: An attempt by Skeletor to steal the Fountain of Life of Aridan from the evil wizard Kothos results in Evil-Lyn and Teela being stranded alone in the middle of the desert.

s01e60.description: Granamyr summons He-Man to his aid to help a young dragon called Torm, who desires to become a human after having fallen in love with a human girl. In order for him to achieve this, he must pass a series of tests, but these can only be undertaken by a human, so He-Man must undertake them on his behalf.

s01e61.description: Teela is taken prisoner by a spacefaring gladiator called the Game Master, who intends to use her as bait to lure He-Man, whom he hopes to capture to take part in his intergalactic games.

s01e62.description: A wizard called Zanthor, exiled to the spirit dimension after selling the Golden Disks of Knowledge to Skeletor, contacts the Sorceress, hoping to amend for his crime by helping He-Man recover the Disks.

s01e63.description: A huntsman called Baron Grod, who kills wild animals so he can preserve them with taxidermy, is after Eternia's last living unicorn. Adam and Teela must set out to save the unicorn and make Grod see the error of his ways.

s01e64.description: Man-At-Arms' mentor Rohad is dying, and He-Man must embark on a search to find a rare plant which provides the only cure to Rohad's illness.

s01e65.description: Orko is on the run from a giant that he believes to be an evil monster, but both he and the giant are taken prisoner by a travelling freak show.
